headline: The Home Depot Reports Q3 Fiscal 2026 Sales of $43.4 Billion
summary: The Home Depot reported third-quarter fiscal 2026 sales of $43.4 billion, representing a 4.9% increase compared to the same period in fiscal 2025. The company also provided an update to its fiscal 2026 guidance.
why: The Home Depot is the world's largest home improvement retailer and a major component of the US retail sector, serving as a key indicator of consumer spending on housing and renovation.

impacts.name: The Home Depot
impacts.why: The company reported quarterly financial results and updated its annual guidance.
